headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate machine learning models to predict potential risks in npm and PyPI packages, including command expansion issues. Utilize natural language processing for better package description understanding and automated binding.gyp file analysis.
actions: Implement an AI model that analyzes package metadata and historical data to flag potentially risky dependencies before installation.
Develop a feature that uses NLP to understand and categorize package descriptions, highlighting known vulnerabilities or suspicious keywords.
Create a module for automated parsing of `binding.gyp` files to identify potential security risks and misconfigurations.
